## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Research/methodology
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests (`python -m pytest -q`)
- [ ] Backend lint (`ruff check .`)
- [ ] Frontend build (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Documentation and data-provenance claims reviewed

## Research and data impact

Describe any changes to datasets, seeds, splits, metrics, model assumptions, or result artifacts. If none, say so.

## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, private data, or unlicensed external data are included.
- [ ] Claims are supported by committed code or results.
- [ ] Relevant docs and tests have been updated.
